response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 76,77,78 in this chapter.

messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي كأعداد صحيحة بأرقام 0-9 فقط، بلا فاصلة أو كلمة ملحقة، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"chapter":16,"verse":76,"text":"You who keep my commandments and precepts,” says the Lord God, “don’t let your sins weigh you down, and don’t let your iniquities lift themselves up.”"},{"chapter":16,"verse":77,"text":"Woe to those who are choked with their sins and covered with their iniquities, like a field is choked with bushes, and its path covered with thorns, that no one may travel through!"},{"chapter":16,"verse":78,"text":"It is shut off and given up to be consumed by fire."}],"chapter":16,"book_code":"2ES"}
